blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouched units as controls, and 400 addresses appear without diacritics. The tables agree with an independent lineage on 10,564 of 10,565 official pairs, disagreements were settled against the resolutions, and the probing-track scorer agrees with both authors' blind labels (Cohen's $κ=0.91$ and $0.89$). Data, outputs, code, and a datasheet are released. In the probing track, at least 20 of 67 models know the reform. Fourteen of them give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses (old province only: 14-100%); a bare date recovers up to 100%. Post hoc (80 province-free addresses, single runs), with reasoning off, today's date in the system prompt leaves 68-100% old-province-only answers for 10 of 12 models; with reasoning, an "as of" prefix in the question leaves none for seven of eight. On the 1,262-item benchmark subset, with same-source old and new passages, small models unaware of the reform give 14-30% outdated answers and the five benchmark-track knowers (also differing in size or provider) 0-5%.
blocks.zh: 2025年7月1日,越南将63个省减至34个,撤销696个县,以3,321个乡级单位(下同)取代了10,035个乡级单位(下同). ViAdminShift是越南有关此事件的一款语言资源,由7,995个基准项目,2,281个从改革前和改革后维基百科修订稿和日期模板中取出段落,以及一个发布的脚本从官方转换表重建的旧到新表格(没有重新分配)组成. 被更改的项目存储了改革前的答案(除了121个地址项目),一个2\times2$的设计使用未触动的单元作为控制器,400个地址出现时没有二极管. 表格与10 564个10 565个正式配对的独立分行一致,解决了与决议的分歧,而探测轨道计分员同意两位作者的盲标(Cohen's $-0.91美元和0.89美元)。 发布数据,输出,代码和数据表. 在探测道上,67个模型中至少有20个知道改革. 其中14个只回答有关旧址的11%的简单问题(只回答14-100%);裸枣恢复了100%。 后临时(80个省免地址,单行),有推理的,今天的系统日期催促为12个模型中的10个给出68-100%的旧省只答;有推理的,问题中的"截至"前缀没有为8个中的7个给出一个. 关于1,262项基准子集,有同源新旧段落,不了解改革的小模型给出了14%-30%的过时答案,五个基准轨道知识者(大小或提供者也不同)给出了0-5%的答案.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: This paper presents ViAdminShift , a Vietnamese language resource built around one real event that changed thousands of facts at once, and reports what it reveals about large language models (LLMs). LLMs are trained on a fixed snapshot of text, while facts keep changing. Many resources sample isolated facts that changed for unrelated reasons, such as a soccer player’s club or an office holder (Section 2 ). Real updates often arrive as events , and a model that has absorbed an event should update every fact it entails. A model may also hold an update without using it, answering a plain question from the old map and a dated one from the new (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 本文介绍 ViAdminShift, 越南语言资源围绕一次真实事件, LLMs接受关于文本的固定快照的培训,而事实却不断改变。 许多资源抽样抽取了个别事实,这些事实因无关原因而发生变化,例如足球运动员俱乐部或一名官员(第2节)。 真实的更新往往会随着事件而来, 模型也可以不使用它而持有更新,回答旧地图上的一个平坦问题和新地图上的一个日期(图一.).

blocks.en:
Vietnam’s 2025 administrative reform is such an event. Adopted on June 12, 2025, Resolution 202/2025/QH15 reduced the 63 provincial-level units to 34: 23 new units were formed by merging two or three old ones, and 11 were left unchanged ( Quốc hội nước Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa Việt
Nam, 2025b ) . The Law on the Organization of Local Government left two levels, province and commune, and ended district governments on July 1, 2025 ( Quốc hội nước Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa Việt
Nam, 2025a ) . At the commune level, the National Assembly Standing Committee approved 3,321 units in place of 10,035, in principle on June 5 ( TTXVN/VietnamPlus, 2025 ) and formally in Resolutions 1654–1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 of June 16, 2025. We call every commune-level unit a ward : xã (rural commune), phường (urban ward), thị trấn (township), or đặc khu (special zone). Every ward of the 52 merged provinces now belongs to a new province, often under another name; almost all wards were merged, renamed, or divided; and every postal address lost its district segment: Phường Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh is now Phường Sài Gòn, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh .

blocks.en:
Three properties make the event a good basis for a language resource. Its date is exact, and it was adopted and reported weeks before the new units began to operate on July 1, 2025 ( TTXVN/VietnamPlus, 2025 ; Quốc hội nước Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa Việt
Nam, 2025b ) , so a model whose training data end in that window may know the headline without the details. Its consequences are specified by official tables, so gold answers are not a matter of judgment. And the units it left untouched form a built-in control group that separates outdated answers from other errors. The change also matters in practice: services must convert addresses between the two structures, open-source converters appeared soon after the reform ( Tran, 2025 ) , and pre- and post-reform documents coexist in retrieval stores. Translating an English temporal benchmark cannot produce such a resource: the sources exist only in Vietnamese, and the facts live in Vietnamese administrative naming, with changed unit-type words, recurring names, and omitted diacritics (Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en: We therefore build ViAdminShift from the official sources: deterministic templates, not an LLM, turn its canonical tables into questions with exact gold and pre-reform answers. The resource supports a sharper question than “does the model know the new map?”: when a model knows the new map, does it use it? We call the behavior in Fig. 1 the temporal default : the model holds both maps and, unless the question is anchored in time, answers from the old one. Log-probability comparisons ( Hossain et al., 2026 ) and answers ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) of pretrained models show a similar preference for older facts; we show it in the generated answers of deployed models, for an event-level change, with premise controls. Alongside strict accuracy (the new name alone), the prespecified headline metric, we report old-only answers (Section 4.5 ), which give a user no sign of being outdated. Our contributions are: ∙ \bullet Canonical tables of the reform. Tables of the units before and after the reform and 10,566 old-to-new ward pairs, derived from the official conversion table ( Cục Thống kê, 2025 ) , checked against an independent source lineage and the resolutions, and rebuilt by a released script (Section 3.1 ). ∙ \bullet A benchmark with built-in controls. Items of seven types, from headline facts to ward-level address conversion, that store the pre-reform answer where it differs (except 121 address items), place ward-level items in a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 design (province changed × \times ward changed), and include diacritic-free address twins (Sections 3.2 – 3.4 ). Eight local models (seven unaware of the reform) and four API models that know it ran all 7,995 items closed-book and, except three API models (1,460), with mixed passages. ∙ \bullet Paired retrieval contexts. Pre- and post-reform revisions of the same Vietnamese Wikipedia articles where they exist, and dated templates for the rest, which supply the new passage of 79% of the items (Section 3.5 ). ∙ \bullet Evaluation sets, scorers, and documentation. Paired item sets that differ only in a temporal cue, a date’s position, or a dropped address component; rule-based scorers with Vietnamese-specific normalization (the probing-track scorer validated against both authors’ blind labels); and a datasheet ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) , a data statement ( Bender and Friedman, 2018 ) , and a versioning plan (Sections 3.6 – 3.7 ). ∙ \bullet What the resource reveals. We probe 67 models (Section 4.2 ). Of the 20 that know the reform, 14 give the new province alone for at most 11% of plain questions about old addresses, and a bare date recovers up to 100% (Section 5.2 ). Post hoc, for most models, a date in the question leaves fewer old-only answers than the same date in the system prompt (Section 5.3 ). In the benchmark track, small models unaware of the reform give outdated answers with mixed passages far more often than the five that know it, which also differ in size or provider (Section 5.4 ).

blocks.en: 2.1 Temporal and outdated knowledge
blocks.zh: 2.1 临时和过时的知识

blocks.en: Early work probed facts that change over time ( Dhingra et al., 2022 ) and answers that depend on when a question is asked ( Zhang and Choi, 2021 ) . TimeQA ( Chen et al., 2021 ) and TempReason ( Tan et al., 2023 ) ask for a Wikidata fact at a time stated in the question (or, in TempReason, relative to another event), TDBench ( Kim et al., 2026 ) generates time-sensitive questions from temporal databases, and other benchmarks follow change through consecutive Wikipedia and Wikidata snapshots ( Jang et al., 2022 ) or regularly refreshed questions ( Kasai et al., 2023 ; Vu et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en: Closest to our design, EvolvingQA ( Kim et al., 2024 ) scores the outdated answer of each edited fact next to the updated one and adds unchanged facts, as our stored old answers and control units do, but GPT-3.5 writes its questions, and it tests the continual pretraining of T5 rather than the prompting of deployed LLMs. ChroKnowBench ( Park et al., 2025 ) contrasts changed facts with independently sampled facts that could have changed but did not; our controls are the units that the same event left untouched. WikiRecentChanges ( Wallat et al., 2026 ) also pairs changed with stable facts. In evolveQA ( Nakshatri et al., 2025 ) , models often pick the current answer in multiple choice but an outdated one in free-form answers. LLMs still give outdated answers ( Tang et al., 2025 ) , and outdated context misleads them ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 与我们的设计相近的是EvolutionQA(Kim et al., 2024)在更新的事实旁边对每一个编辑事实的过时答案进行评分,并添加了不变的事实,就像我们存储的旧答案和控制单位所做的那样,但是GPT-3.5写了自己的问题,它测试了T5的持续预训而不是提示部署的LLM. ChroKnow Bench(Park等,2025年)将改变的事实与本来可以改变但却没有改变的独立抽样的事实形成对比;我们的控制是同一事件未触及的单位。 维基最近 变化 (Wallat等, 2026) 也以稳定的事实改变对. 在进化QA(Nakshatri等,2025年)中,模型常常在多个选择中选择当前答案,但在自由形式答案中却是一个过时的答案. LLMs仍然给出了过时的答案(Tang等,2025年),而过时的上下文误导了他们(Zhu等,2025年).

blocks.en: Hossain et al. (2026) define parametric temporal conflict (PTC): in four open-weight base models, the older position holder outscores the newer, still recoverable one for 4.1–10.3% of the retained transitions, and a one-line date prefix restores the newer holder in 61–81% of these. ViAdminShift instead covers one real, event-level update, with stored pre-reform answers and unchanged units as a built-in control.
blocks.zh: Hossain等人(2026年)定义了参数时相冲突(PTC):在四种开放量基模型中,较老的位置持有者比较新位置者多出分数,对于4.1-10.3%的保留过渡仍可收回一分数,单行日期前缀在其中61-81%恢复了较新位置持有者. ViAdminShift则涵盖了一个真实的,事件级的更新,存储了改革前的答案和不变的单元作为内置控制.

blocks.en: 2.2 Where the present date is given
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 现日期

blocks.en: Prior resources fix the present implicitly or state the date in fixed positions (Table 1 ). A date-and-cutoff prefix brings mostly small gains ( Wallat et al., 2026 ) , and a date hint that precedes the model’s cutoff changes accuracy little ( Nakshatri et al., 2025 ) . Sanz-Guerrero et al. (2026) show that the chat templates of Llama 3.1 and gpt-oss, and some API providers, insert the current date into the system prompt, and that changing only this date moves scores on time-independent benchmarks by up to 14 points. Herel et al. (2025) compare wordings of a date prefix in one position, and in RT-QA ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , search agents given the timestamp in the system prompt re-anchor to past dates that they retrieve. Placement matters for other prompt content, such as the answer instruction of an Italian benchmark ( Musacchio et al., 2026 ) ; we compare system-prompt, in-question, earlier-turn, and tool placements of the same date on time-sensitive facts (post hoc; Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 先前的资源隐含地确定现值或以固定职位说明日期(表1)。 日期和截止日期前缀主要带来小收益(Wallat等,2026年),而日期提示则在模型的截止日期前改变准确度很小(Nakshatri等,2025年)。 Sanz-Guerrero等人(2026年)显示,Llama 3.1和gpt-oss的聊天模板以及一些API提供商将当前日期插入到系统快取中,仅更改这个日期就可以将时间独立基准的分数移动到最多14分. 赫来等. (2025年)将一个位置上的日期前缀的措辞进行比较,在RT-QA(周等,2026年)中,由于系统中的时间戳,搜索代理迅速重新锁定它们检索到的过去的日期. 其他快速内容的安放事项,例如意大利基准的回答指示(Musacchio等,2026年);我们比较系统即时、问题、早转和同一天的工具安放时间敏感的事实(事后临时;第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 2.3 Knowledge conflicts, outdated retrieval, and editing
blocks.zh: 2.3 知识冲突、过时检索和编辑

blocks.en: When retrieved context contradicts parametric memory, fine-tuned QA readers overrely on memorized answers under entity substitution ( Longpre et al., 2021 ) , while LLMs accept coherent counterevidence but, given both supporting and conflicting evidence, often side with memory ( Xie et al., 2024 ) . Outdated documents in a retrieval store distract models from current information ( Ouyang et al., 2025 ) , and several versions of a fact in context mislead models ( Özer and Yıldız, 2025 ) . Many conflict sets use substituted, constructed, or LLM-generated contexts ( Longpre et al., 2021 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Wallat et al., 2026 ) , whereas each of our mixed passages was true at its date: a real Wikipedia revision or, without an article, a dated template (Section 3.5 ).
blocks.zh: 当被检索到的上下文与参数内存相矛盾时,微调QA的读者在实体替换(Longpre等,2021年)下过度地记取了被记住的答案;而LLMs则接受连贯的反证,但考虑到支持性和相冲突性的证据,往往与内存并列(Xie等,2024年). 一个检索商店中过时的文件分散了模型对当前信息的注意力(Ouyang等人,2025年),以及上下文中若干版本的事实误导了模型(Özer和Yıldız,2025年)。 许多冲突设定使用替换、构建或LLM生成的背景(Longpre等,2021年;Xie等,2024年;Wallat等,2026年),而我们混合的每个段落在其日期都是真实的:一个真实的维基百科修订版,或者在没有文章的情况下,一个有日期的模板(第3.5节)。

blocks.en: Knowledge-editing benchmarks ask whether an injected fact spreads to entailed and multi-hop facts ( Cohen et al., 2024 ) , and work on event-level editing ( Peng et al., 2024 ) argues that real updates arrive as events that change many triples at once. Many of these edits are counterfactual or constructed, and even real-change subsets, such as the Recent subset of RippleEdits ( Cohen et al., 2024 ) , inject each change as an independent triple. The reform is a real event-level “edit”: we edit nothing and ask whether a model that knows the headline carries it to the entailed ward-level facts.
blocks.zh: Knowledge-edition basics询问一个被注入的事实是否传播到连带的事实和多跳的事实(Cohen等,2024年),以及事件层面编辑工作(Peng等,2024年)认为,真实更新的到来是一次改变许多三重事件. 许多这些编辑都是反事实或构造的,甚至真变化子集,如RippleEdits(Cohen等,2024年)的最近子集,将每个变化注入一个独立的三相. 改革是一个真正的事件层面的“编辑”:我们不编辑任何内容,并问一个知道标题的模型是否将标题带入必然的病房层面的事实。

blocks.en: 2.4 Vietnamese and Southeast Asian evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.4 越南和东南亚评价

blocks.en: Vietnamese LLM benchmarks cover school exams with geography questions ( Dao et al., 2023 ) , general multitask understanding ( Nguyen et al., 2024 ; Bui et al., 2025 ) , and law. VLegal-Bench ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) reports “recency blindness” in article prediction (models pick outdated legislation over 2024–2025 instruments) and includes one task on amendment and replacement relations between legal documents, but none of these benchmarks is built around a real-world knowledge update. AC-IQuAD ( Doxolodeo and Krisnadhi, 2025 ) generates Indonesian questions from Wikidata triples and reports that low-content, probably bot-created Wikipedia articles on districts skewed its questions toward administrative units; most Vietnamese wards have no article, so many of our passages are generated from the tables (Section 3.5 ).

blocks.en: Table 2 lists the seven item types: T0 , T2 , and T6 ask about headline and province-level facts, and T1 , T4 , T5 , and part of T3 about the facts that the reform entails for individual wards. T1 , T5 , and T6 items come in three cue variants that differ only in a prefix (Section 4.3 ). Items whose answer changed also store the pre-reform answer ( old_answer ), which multiple-choice items include as a distractor, so a wrong answer can be labeled outdated . The field is empty where the two answers coincide, for 121 T4 items whose ward and province names did not change, and for 87 new-name T1 items about wards whose name did not exist before the reform (2,989 items in all).

blocks.en: The control cells ( wc = 0 \textsc{wc}{}=0 ) are used in full, and the two changed cells are sampled round-robin over old provinces, using only old wards whose names changed: for pc = 1 \textsc{pc}{}=1 the province name, and for wc = 1 \textsc{wc}{}=1 the bare name of every successor. Ward-level items ( T1 , T3 – T5 ) cover 1,708 of the 10,035 old wards and 57 of the 63 old provinces. In 849 T4 and T5 items with a changed answer (109 of the 1,262-item subset of Section 4.1 ), the new ward’s bare name occurs in the question, compared without diacritics (118 of them are diacritic-free T4 twins). In 779 of them (104 in the subset), the ward was renamed, so the answer can be copied; the other 70 are T4 addresses of wards that kept their name, where only the province changed and nothing is leaked. We remove the 779 items from the 2 × 2 2{\times}2 analysis and the released per-type tables. Elsewhere they are kept, and removing them changes accuracy by at most 4.1 percentage points closed-book and 4.8 points with a retrieved context, for any model and condition (all 849: 4.1 and 5.4).

blocks.en: Naming. White space separates every syllable, so it does not mark word boundaries ( Nguyen et al., 2018 ) . Both scorers therefore strip the unit-type word before each name (the reform changed this word for some units) and match names as sequences of whole syllables. The benchmark-track scorer also compares that word by level and never accepts thành phố (a city or a district) for a ward. Names recur: 43% of pre-reform wards share their bare name with another ( Tân Thành occurs 34 times), so every item about an old ward names its old district and province.
blocks.zh: 取名问. 白地空间将每个音节相分离,因此不会标出词边界(Nguyen等,2018年). 因此,两个记分员将每个名称之前的单位型单词剥去(改革为部分单位更改了这个单词)并匹配名称作为全音节的序列. 基准轨道计分员也按级别比较该词,绝不接受被监护人的t'nh phæ(城市或地区). 名称重复:43%的改革前的被监护人与另一个人共享其裸名(Tân Thánh发生34次),因此每个关于一个旧被监护人的物品都取出其旧区和省名.

blocks.en: Spelling. Users often type Vietnamese without diacritics, which makes text ambiguous ( Dang and Nguyen, 2020 ) : without them, 17.5% of pre-reform wards share their name with a differently spelled ward ( Tân Thanh , Tân Thành , Tân Thạnh ). Half of the 800 T4 addresses therefore also appear as diacritic-free twins, which the benchmark-track scorer matches without diacritics, mapping đ to d . Tone marks in oa , oe , and uy follow one of two conventions ( Hòa or Hoà ) that Unicode normalization (NFC) does not unify. Both scorers unify them (and dashes), which changes 147 of 121,324 cue-ladder labels (post hoc).
blocks.zh: 拼写. 用户经常在打越南语时没有二分法,这使得文字模糊不清(Dang and Nguyen, 2020):没有他们,17.5%的改革前病房与一个拼写不同的病房(Tân Thanh, Tân Thanh, Tân Thannh)共享自己的名字. 因此,800个T4地址中的一半也作为无双胞胎出现,基准轨比分器在无双胞胎比对时,将 到d. 在 oa, oe, yy 中, 两种计分器都统一了它们(和破折号),这在121,324个Cue-ladder标签(后特设)中改变了147个.

blocks.en: 3.5 Retrieval contexts
blocks.zh: 3.5 检索背景

blocks.en: For each province and district article of Vietnamese Wikipedia, we take the last revision before June 12, 2025, that does not yet describe the reform, and the last revision before January 1, 2026, if it postdates July 15, 2025. Passages are excerpts of at most 1,250 characters from the lead or the administrative section. Most wards have no article, so the other items use template passages generated from the canonical tables in the same format, dated June 1 or October 1, 2025, and citing the relevant resolution. The 2,281 passages used are 1,002 Wikipedia excerpts (575 old, 427 new) and 1,279 templates (277 old, 1,002 new). The new condition shows the relevant new passage(s), and the mixed condition old and new passages in a fixed shuffled order.
blocks.zh: 对于越南维基百科的每个省份和地区文章,我们拿2025年6月12日前的最后一次修订,这个版本还没有描述改革,而2026年1月1日前的最后一次修订,如果是在2025年7月15日之后. 通道是主干或行政科最多1 250个字符的节选。 大多数病房没有文章,因此其他物品使用从同格式的犬目表生成的模板段落,日期为2025年6月1日或10月1日并引用了相关的决议. 使用的2,281个段落有1,002个维基百科节选(575个旧,427个新)和1,279个模板(277个旧,1,002个新). 新條件出自相關的新道(s),以固定的洗牌顺序出自相關的新道(s),并出自相關的混合條件"新道".

blocks.en: 3.6 Quality control
blocks.zh: 3.6 质量控制

blocks.en: The adjudication of Section 3.1 used HTML reproductions of the resolutions, not the official scans; the manual checks used the official texts. The authors found no error in 53 manual checks: 30 random mapping rows (seed 13, from 30 different new provinces) with the full composition of their new wards; 11 targeted checks of divided, conflicting, or corrected units; and the gold answers of the 12 T0 items, checked against Resolution 202/2025/QH15. The authors read every cited clause and made each judgment themselves; the checklist was prepared with Claude’s help. Audit code written separately from the generator (both with Claude’s help) rederived the gold and old answers of the other 7,983 items and found no gold error; a linter found no old answer scored as correct and no malformed options.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节的裁决使用了决议的HTML复制,而不是官方扫描;人工检查使用了官方文本. 作者发现53个人工检查没有出错:30个随机绘图行(种子13个,来自30个不同的新省份),其新病房全部组成;11个定向检查被分割、相冲突或被更正的单位;12个T0物品的黄金答案,与第202/2025/QH15号决议核对. 提交人阅读了所引用的每一个条款,并自己作出了每个判决;清单是在克洛德的帮助下编制的。 与生成器分开写的审计代码(两者都由克洛德帮助)重现了其他7,983项的黄金和旧答案,没有发现黄金出错;一个linter发现没有旧答案得分为正确,也没有错误的选项.

blocks.en: The two authors, both native speakers, labeled 200 probing-track answers to absorbed T1 and T1np units (Section 4.3 ; 40 per scorer label when sampled, both split by name order) independently and blind: their sheets showed neither the scorer’s label nor the model and listed the rows in different orders. They agree with each other on 97% ( κ = 0.96 \kappa=0.96 ) and with the scorer on 93% and 92% ( κ = 0.91 \kappa=0.91 and 0.89 0.89 ). Most disagreements (13 of 14 and 15 of 17) go against the scoring rules, which the authors know: for an answer that names both provinces, the scorer takes the name given first and the guideline the province the answer commits to. The scorer thus undercounts new-first answers: the annotators read about a third of its sampled old-first answers as new-first, among them long explanations that end on the new province (including all four sampled from Claude Opus 4.8). Besides the copyable items, two item issues remain: 19 T3 items about new wards do not separate outdated from updated models, and three T1 items about Xã Đồng Nai name its new province.
blocks.zh: 两位作者都是本地人,为吸收的T1和T1np单位标注了200个检测-跟踪答案(第4.3节;抽样时每个计分器标签40个,都按名称顺序分开)独立和盲从:他们的床单既没有显示计分器的标签,也没有显示模型,并以不同的顺序列出行. 双方就97%(=0.96\kappa=0.96)和93%和92%(=0.91\kappa=0.91和0.890.89)的分数达成一致。 大多数分歧(14分和17分中15分)都违反评分规则,作者知道:对于给两个省份取名的答案,计分员先取所给的名并按所承诺的省份取出准则。 计分员因此低估了新的第一答案:注释员将它抽样的旧第一答案的大约三分之一读作新第一,其中包括以新省份为终点的长篇解释(包括从克洛德·奥普斯4.8中抽取的所有四个样本). 除了可复制的物品之外,还有两个问题:19个关于新病房的T3物品没有从更新的模型中分离出过时的物品;3个关于QĐồng Nai的T1物品取出其新省名.

blocks.en: 3.7 Release, versioning, and maintenance
blocks.zh: 3.7 国家 发布、版本和维护

blocks.en: The release contains the items, the retrieval contexts, the evaluation sets of Section 4 (with the exact prompts), the model outputs behind every result, the scorers, the analysis scripts, and a datasheet ( Gebru et al., 2021 ) . Data, model outputs, and annotation sheets are released under CC BY-SA 4.0 (required for the Wikipedia passages; outputs of tiny-aya-global: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), and the code under the MIT license; users of hosted-model outputs must also follow the providers’ terms. The items contain only unit names, old-to-new assignments, and official unit codes, facts set by public legal acts. The NSO file carries no explicit license; no source file with NSO or government-portal data is redistributed, nor are the canonical tables, which reproduce the NSO file as a whole; the released code downloads these files and, if they match the versions used here, rebuilds the tables byte for byte.
blocks.zh: 发布内容包括项目,检索背景,第4节的评价集(带有精确的提示),每个结果背后的模型输出,分数,分析脚本,以及一个数据表(Gebru等,2021年). 在CC BY-SA 4.0(维基百科段落需要;微小-aya-Global: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)和麻省理工学院许可下的代码下发布数据,模型输出和注释表;主机模型输出的用户也必须遵守提供者的条款. 这些物品只包含单位名称,旧到新任务,以及官方单位代码,由公共法令规定的事实. 国家统计局文件没有明确的许可证;没有重新分配国家统计局的源文件或政府门户数据,也没有重新分发完整复制国家统计局文件的犬形表格;发布的代码下载了这些文件,如果它们与这里使用的版本相匹配,则重建表格字节为字节.

blocks.en: Version 2025-07-01 describes the structure in force on July 1, 2025 (“old” is the structure on June 30, 2025). Items about the present (“now,” hiện nay ) refer to this date, and gold answers under the later date cue assume that no name or membership changed in between. Later changes we know of concern unit type only. Between April 30 and September 20, 2026, Đồng Nai, Quảng Ninh, and Bắc Ninh became centrally run cities with the same name and territory (Resolutions 30, 36, and 39/2026/QH16), and 10 xã of Đồng Nai and 12 of Bắc Ninh became phường under the same names (Resolutions 237 and 388/NQ-UBTVQH16). The date in the “as of” cue and in the “today is” sentence (Section 4.3 ) falls after the 2025 reform and after all of these 2026 changes. Because the scorers strip unit-type words and options differ by name, only T3 items, which name the unit type, are affected: four of them ( T3-prov-22 , -27 , -75 , and T3-dist-256 ) are correct only at the version date, and none about a ward names one of the 22 communes that became phường. Later versions will be rebuilt from then-current official sources, and released versions will remain unchanged. The resource is maintained by the corresponding author; errors can be reported on the repository’s issue tracker, and confirmed corrections are listed in the changelog.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Two evaluation tracks
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 两个评价轨道

blocks.en: Figure 4: Evaluation design. Top: the gold and outdated answers that both tracks share, and the benchmark track’s conditions. Left: the probing track’s cue ladder, its knowledge gate (purple), and where a date can be given. Right: how probing-track answers are labeled and counted as strict accuracy (prespecified), new-first, and old-only (the last two post hoc). Green, new name; red, old name; yellow, both names; blue, the added cue or date; gray italics, English glosses.
blocks.zh: 图4:评价设计。 Top:两个轨道共享的黄金和过时答案,以及基准轨道的条件. 左:探测轨道的提示梯子,其知识门(purple),以及可以给出日期的地方. 右:如何将探测轨道的答案贴上标签,并算作严格的准确度(预先确定),新一和旧一(最后两个后特设). 绿色,新取名;红色,旧取名;黄色,两个取名;蓝色,所增加的提示或日期;灰色斜体,英文拼音.

blocks.en: Both tracks take gold and outdated answers from the canonical tables (Section 3.1 ; Fig. 4 , top). The probing track uses small, paired short-answer sets whose questions exist in versions that differ only in a cue, a system prompt, or one dropped component, so comparisons are paired by unit. The benchmark track runs all 7,995 released items (Section 3.3 ) or a seeded 1,262-item subset stratified by item type and format, covering every 2 × 2 2{\times}2 cell, closed-book and under the new and mixed conditions of Section 3.5 , the latter also with dated passage headers (+date). Eight local models ran it (seven small ones of 1.7B to 4B unaware of the reform, and Muse-Glimmer-30B, which ran new and +date only on the subset), as did four API models aware of it: DeepSeek-V4.1 -Flash on all items in all conditions, and GPT-6-Luna, Claude Haiku 5.5, and Sonnet 5.5, which ran with passages only on the subset and the 220 items with a new Wikipedia excerpt and an old template passage (22 of them in the subset; 1,460 in all).
blocks.zh: 两道轨道都取自金色和过时的答案取自方言表(第3.1节;图4,上)。 探测道使用小而成对的短答集,其问题存在于只有一个提示,一个系统提示,或者一个被丢放的组件的版本中,因此比较按单位对等. 基准轨道运行所有7 995个已放出的项目(第3.3节)或1 262个种子子集,按项目类型和格式进行分级,每2×2 2 ×times}2个单元格,封闭本,并在第3.5节的新和混合条件下,后者还带有有日期的段落标题(+日期)。 8个本地模式运行了它(1.7B到4B的7个小模式没有意识到改革,而Muse-Glimer-30B只在子集上运行了新的和+date),4个API模式也意识到了这一点:DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在所有条件下的所有项目上运行,而GPT-6-Luna,克洛德·海库·5.5,和Sonnet 5.5则只运行于子集上有段落,220个项目带有新的维基百科节录和旧模板段落(其中22个在子集中;总共1,460个).

blocks.en: 4.2 Models and inference
blocks.zh: 4.2 模型和推论

blocks.en: Table 3: Evaluated models by access route (number in parentheses). Local model names state the size, except Ling-3.0-tiny; most API models do not disclose it. The last column gives the requested setting and, for three routes, the measured share of cue-ladder items with reasoning (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表3:按访问路线(括号内的数字)评估的模型。 本地型号名称说明其大小,除了Ling-3.0-tiny;大多数API型号不披露. 最后一栏给出了所要求的设置,对于三个路线,则给出了有推理的Cue-ladder项的测量份额(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: We evaluate 67 distinct models, 26 local and 41 only through APIs, with Qwen3.8-27B on both routes (Table 3 ); reruns for route and reasoning comparisons are not counted. Local models use Q8_0 GGUF weights, except gpt-oss-20B (MXFP4) and, in the probing track only, nine that we converted to bf16. The reseller OmniRoute does not name its upstream provider; with no cue, Claude Opus 5.5 answers 41 of the same 80 absorbed T1 units correctly through the first-party API and 44 through the reseller, and Qwen3.8-27B fails the gate on both routes.
blocks.zh: 我们只通过API评价67个不同的模型,26个本地模型和41个本地模型,两条路线都有Qune3.8-27B(表3);路线和推理比较的重跑不计算. 本地模型使用Q8_0 GGUF权重,除了gpt-oss-20B(MXFP4)外,仅在探测轨道上,我们转换为bf16的有9个. 转卖商OmniRoute没有命名其上游供应商;没有提示,克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus 5.5)通过一党API正确回答同80个被吸收的T1单元中的41个,再通过转卖商44个,而Qune3.8-27B在两条路线上都故障了大门.

blocks.en: Decoding is greedy (temperature 0) where the API accepts it (not for Claude models from Opus 4.7 on), and reasoning is set as low as each route allows (Table 3 ). Because API flags do not reveal whether a model reasoned, we measure it: an item counts as reasoned if the API returns reasoning text or the reported completion tokens exceed the visible length (UTF-8 bytes/3) by more than 40, which holds for 3,056 of the 3,057 cue-ladder items of Claude Opus 5.5 and for no placement item of DeepSeek-V4.1 -Flash. The measure also shows reasoning on most reseller models despite the disabled flag (Table 3 ); the knowers (Section 4.4 ) GPT-6, GPT-5.5 , Kimi-K3 , and GLM-5.3 reasoned on 97–100% of absorbed items with today’s date in the system prompt. GPT-6 and Kimi-K3 were therefore rerun via OpenRouter with reasoning off and on for the date experiments; the other reseller models were not rerun. Benchmark-track answers are capped at 16/64 tokens (MCQ/short; Muse-Glimmer 1,024, without its template date) and scored even if truncated. Claude answers that hit the cap were re-asked at 64/128, then 512 (Sonnet started at 64/128; all cut answers but Haiku’s 296 at 64/128 are released); 85 Sonnet answers remain truncated. Counting as invalid Sonnet’s 221 subset answers longer than any uncut answer of Haiku’s 16/64 pass (12 UTF-8 bytes for MCQ, 153 for short) lowers its closed-book subset accuracy from 71% to 63%. Sonnet ran as in its no-thinking probe, Haiku and GPT-6-Luna via OpenRouter (temperature 0 requested, reasoning off, provider not recorded; Haiku’s gate probe on the first-party API); reasoning was not measured.
blocks.zh: 解码是贪婪(temperature 0),API接受它(不是Claude models from Opus 4.7 on),推理被设定为每条路线允许的低等(表3. 因为API旗没有显示一个模型是否合理,所以我们测量它:如果API返回推理文本或报告的完成符超过可见长度(UTF-8字节/3)超过40个,一个项目算作合理,它持有克洛德·奥普斯5.5的3,056个Claude-Opus的Clue-lader项中的3,056个,并且没有DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的放置项. 尽管旗子已失效(表3),但该措施还展示了大多数再销售模型的推理(第4.4节)GPT-6、GPT-5.5、Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3,其推理依据是97-100%的被吸收物品在系统上的日期。 因此,GPT-6和Kimi-K3通过OpenRouter重新运行,同时进行推理并进行日期实验;其他再销售模型没有重新运行. 基准轨道答案上限为16/64令牌(MCQ/short;Muse-Glimer 1 024,没有其模板日期)并得分,即使截取. 盖帽的克洛德(Claude)的回答在64/128被重新询问,然后是512(索内特从64/128开始;除了海库的296在64/128被发布之外,所有被剪接的答案都被解开);85 Sonnet的回答仍然被截断. 计算为无效的 Sonnet 的 221 子集解答时间比 Haiku 16/64 的 16/64 通关(MCQ为 12 UTF-8 字节,简称为 153 个) 的任何未剪接的解答时间长,使其闭页子集的准确性从 71% 降低到 63%. Sonnet在无思维探测器中运行, Haiku和GPT-6-Luna通过OpenRouter运行(要求温度0, 推理, 提供者没有记录; Haiku的大门探测器在第一党API上); 推理没有被测量.

blocks.en: Each cell is a single run (repeats for four models: Section 6.4 ). Hosted models can change behind a fixed identifier, need not be deterministic under greedy decoding ( Atıl et al., 2025 ) , and may add the current date ( Sanz-Guerrero et al., 2026 ) , so the released outputs are the reference for every number. Only the reseller was probed for a provider-added date: GPT-5.5 knew today’s date in all seven probes, so its no-cue conditions are not date-free; GPT-6, Kimi-K3, and both GLM-5.3 models did not (one-off recitations of a dated system prompt by Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 did not recur).
blocks.zh: 每个细胞是一个单跑(重复四个型号: 第6.4节. 被托管的模型可以在固定识别符后改变,不需要在贪婪的解码下确定(Atıl等,2025年),并可能添加当前日期(Sanz-Guerrero等,2026年),因此所释放的产出是每个数字的参考. 只有回售器被探测到一个供应商添加的日期:GPT-5.5在全部7个探测器中都知道今天的日期,因此它的无阴性条件并非无日期;GPT-6,Kimi-K3,以及GLM-5.3两种型号都没有出现(对由Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3所提示的过时系统的一次性回读没有再发生).

blocks.en: 4.3 The cue ladder and date placement
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 提示阶梯和日期设置

blocks.en: Each question is asked at three cue levels that differ only in a prefix (Fig. 4 , left): none ; date , “Tính đến tháng ⟨ \langle MM/YYYY ⟩ \rangle , …” ( as of ⟨ \langle month year ⟩ \rangle ); and reform , “Sau đợt sắp xếp đơn vị hành chính năm 2025, …” ( after the 2025 reorganization ). Here and below, the date is a fixed post-reform date close to the time of the runs, the same in every prompt except the pre-reform controls; the exact strings are in the released item files. Every prompt ends with a brevity suffix ( answer briefly with the name only; do not explain ). Probes are short-answer versions of the T6 , T1 , and T5 items of Table 2 . In T6 and T1 , absorbed units (the old province merged into a differently named one) are the test and kept units the control; T1np drops the province and uses only ward–district pairs unique nationwide, so the old province must be recalled, not copied. In T5 , renamed wards are the test and unrenamed ones the control, excluding items whose new ward name occurs in the old address (ignoring tone placement post hoc). The base set has 549 items: the 63 old provinces in T6 (29 absorbed, 34 kept) and 120 T1 units (80 absorbed, 40 kept). Knowers also answer 360 T1np items (120 units), some models a 2,589-item extension (63 provinces, 400 T1 and 400 T5 units), and the two DeepSeek models and Qwen3-4B its superset with 1,000 absorbed T1 units.

blocks.en: Date placement (post hoc). On the none questions of T6 , T1 , and T1np (303 items), a plain system prompt ( you are a helpful assistant ) is compared with the same prompt plus “Hôm nay là ngày ⟨ \langle DD/MM/YYYY ⟩ \rangle .” ( today is ⟨ \langle date ⟩ \rangle ). This “today is” sentence and the “as of” date each appear in the system prompt (there as an instruction) or in the question (four cells), and two controls give a pre-reform date (January 1, 2025, as today’s date in the system prompt, or “as of January 2025” in the question). Six models with reasoning off repeat the four cells on 300 absorbed T1np units from all 29 absorbed provinces. Agent settings give the date in an earlier turn, as a prior get_current_date result, or through an offered tool (with or without a call instruction), or let DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, told the date, rewrite each question first. In Muse-Glimmer’s chat template, the block stating its cutoff and today’s date becomes no date, the cutoff only, or a pre-reform date. Further controls use post-reform ward names (240 wards), “hiện nay” ( currently ) or a content-free filler as prefix, no brevity suffix (three models), and three repeats of the 80 absorbed T1 units (four models).

blocks.en: 4.4 Prespecified criteria
blocks.zh: 4.4 具体标准

blocks.en: After a pilot (284 items, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) had suggested the effect, and before scoring the final ladder, we recorded these criteria in writing. A model knows the update (a knower ) if its strict accuracy on absorbed T1 units at reform is at least 0.50 (the knowledge gate ). Its knowledge is cue-dependent if reform − - none on those units is at least 0.30 with a paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval excluding 0; as the gate requires 0.50 at reform , a knower can miss this only with a no-cue accuracy above 0.20. Premise-leak control : in models below the gate, reform − - none on absorbed units must stay below 0.15, and in all models | | reform − - none | | on kept units below 0.10; otherwise the cue effect is reported as partly premise-induced. Generality requires at least two model families that know the update to be cue-dependent. A validity rule in the gate script, not part of the recorded criteria, marks runs (one model and setting on one item set) with more than 20% empty outputs as invalid rather than negative. All other analyses, including every date-placement, agent, and template experiment, are post hoc and labeled as such in Section 5 ; benchmark-track analyses are descriptive.
blocks.zh: 在一位飞行员(284项,Deepseek-V4.1-Flash)提出效果后,在给最终梯子打分之前,我们以书面形式记录了这些标准. 一个模型知道更新(一个知道者),如果它在改革时对被吸收的T1单元的严格准确性至少是0.50(知识门). 如果改革 - - - - - 在这些单位上,没有至少0.30个单位拥有一对双靴子95%的置信间隔,不包括0;因为门在改革时需要0.50分,那么知道者只能以0.20分以上的无克精度错过这一点。 精确漏出控制:在闸门下方的模型中,改革 - - - - 任何被吸收的单元都不得低于0.15,在所有模型中 - - - 改革 - - - 任何被保留在0.10以下的单元上均不得存在;否则,提示效应被报告为部分前提引起的。 通俗性需要至少两个知道更新的模范家庭来依赖提示. 门脚本中的有效性规则,不是录入的标准的一部分,标记运行(一个模型并设置在一个项目集上),超过20%的空输出无效而不是负. 所有其他分析,包括每一项日期、剂和模板试验,都是事后特别分析,并列为第5节;基准轨道分析是描述性的。

blocks.en: 4.5 Scoring
blocks.zh: 4.5 分数

blocks.en: The probing-track scorer (Fig. 4 , right; validated in Section 3.6 ) removes reasoning text and unit-type words (Section 3.4 ), normalizes answers (Unicode NFC, lowercase), and matches them as whole names against the gold and old names, with a small alias list. An answer is correct if it names only the new unit, outdated if only the old one, both if both, and other if neither (wrong unit, refusal, or empty). Strict accuracy (correct only) is the prespecified headline metric; counting both , which the recorded criteria did not anticipate, as not correct is a deviation that changes no gate decision. Post hoc, we split both by the name given first: new-first is correct plus both with the new name first, and old-only is outdated. The benchmark-track scorer also parses MCQ letters, labels unparsable answers and abstentions invalid , and counts Thừa Thiên Huế (renamed Huế on January 1, 2025) as outdated, which the probing-track scorer does not (kept units only). For short answers, it scores the whole first line, else an address segment by segment (a three-level one is outdated) and any other answer by the clause after a relation verb (unless negated), the first segment, or any name outside past clauses; one whose scored part names both the gold and the old unit is wrong, not both . Post hoc rules read a lone MCQ letter, name, or address on the last line, changing 15 labels of Haiku 5.5, 610 of Sonnet 5.5, and 69 of two small models.
blocks.zh: 探险-轨道计分器(图4,右;在第3.6节中被验证)去掉推理文字和单位型单词(第3.4节),使答案正常化(Unicode NFC,小写),并将其整体名称与金和旧名相匹配,并有小别名列表. 如果只取出新单位的名称,则答案是正确的,如果是旧单位,如果两者兼而有之(错误单位、拒绝或空)。 严格准确性(仅更正)是预设的头条衡量标准;计及两者,记录标准没有预料到,因为不正确的是更改闸口决定的偏差. 后特设,我们先用给定的名字分开:新一号是正确的,再加上新一号是正确的,旧一号是过时的。 基准轨比分计分者还解析了MCQ字母,标签上无法解析的答案和弃权无效,并算作Thitcha Thiên Huwal (2025年1月1日更名为Huwal)已过时,而探测轨比分者并没有这样做(仅保留单位). 对于简短的答案,它会给整个一行打分,否则会给地址段逐行打分(一个三等一已经过时了),在关系动词(除非否定),第一分线后,或过去条款外的任何名称后通过条款的任何其他答案;一个其得分的部分既取出黄金名称,又取出旧单位名称都是错误的,而不是两者都是错误的. 后临时规则在最后一行读取了单独的MCQ字母,名称,或地址,更改了海库5.5的15个标签,Sonnet 5.5的610个标签和两个小模型的69个标签.

blocks.en: 4.6 Uncertainty
blocks.zh: 4.6 不确定性

blocks.en: Absorbed wards of one old province share their old and new province, so unit-level intervals are too narrow ( Miller, 2024 ) . Every interval is a paired cluster bootstrap ( Field and Welsh, 2007 ) over old provinces ( B = 10,000 B=10{,}000 ; 24 or 29 provinces for absorbed units, 22 to 34 for kept units, and 7 to 11 for those in the 11 unchanged provinces), and an effect counts as established only when this 95% interval excludes zero and a Rademacher wild cluster bootstrap test gives p < 0.05 p<0.05 ( Cameron and Miller, 2015 ) . Both postdate the fixed criteria: the prespecified criteria were evaluated with a unit-level paired bootstrap ( B = 2,000 B=2{,}000 ), and clustering changes no prespecified decision of the 20 knowers. Over their reported runs, it removes the support of 10 cue effects established at the unit level (9 on kept units), and 18 more fail the wild test. At 0% or 100%, resampling intervals collapse ( Bowyer et al., 2025 ) ; 0/80 is then compatible with true rates up to 14.2% (one-sided 97.5% Clopper–Pearson bound, treating the 24 provinces as the effective sample size). Intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons, and by our power calculation (after Card et al., 2020 , with a design effect of about 2), the 80-unit sets detect only differences of roughly 20 points or more.
blocks.zh: 一个老省被吸收的病房共享其新旧省份,因此单位级间隔太窄(Miller,2024. 每个间隔都是一对相接的集群靴(Field and Welsh, 2007),覆盖了旧省份(B=10,000 B=10{,}000;24个或29个被吸收的省份,22至34个被保留单位,7至11个未改变的省份),只有当95%的间隔排除了零,而拉德马赫野生集群靴测试给出了 < 0.05 p < 0.05 (Cameron and Miller, 2015) 时,效果才算数。 这两项标准都贴在日期之后:预先确定的标准用一个单位级的配对靴子(B =2,000 B = 2{,}000)来评价,集群改变没有预先确定20个知情者的决定。 在报告运行期间,它消除了在单位一级确定的10个提示效应(9个保留单位)的支持,还有18个未通过野生测试。 在0%或100%时,再生间隔倒闭(Bowyer等,2025年);然后0/80与14.2%的实际速率相匹配(单侧97.5% Clopper-Pearson 捆绑,将24个省份作为有效样本大小)。 间距不为多相比较而纠正,通过我们的功率计算(Card等,2020年后,设计效果为约2),80个单元只检测出大约20分或以上的差异.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Bracketed intervals are province-clustered 95% intervals in percentage points (added post hoc; Section 4.6 ), and models run in the reasoning setting of Section 4.2 unless stated otherwise. Per-model tables with unit-level and clustered intervals are released.

blocks.en: 5.1 Few models know the reform
blocks.zh: 5.1 很少有模式知道改革

blocks.en: The prespecified knowledge gate (Section 4.4 ) leaves 20 knowers among the 67 distinct models (Table 3 ); Fig. 5 names them. Only one of the 26 local open-weight models, Muse-Glimmer-30B, passes. The others, up to 35B parameters, rarely give the new province under any cue (strict accuracy on absorbed T1 units at most 5%). Three OpenRouter models below the gate answered only its 80 items ( Mistral-Large-4 , Gemini-4-Argon, and LongCat-2.0), so their no-cue rates and premise leak are unknown. Three runs are invalid (Section 4.4 ; ∗ in Table 3 ) and count neither as knowers nor as non-knowers, although two of them pass the gate despite their empty outputs (Muse-Spark-1.2, 97%; Qwen3.8-Flash, 56%), so the knower count is a lower bound. Closed-book on all 7,995 benchmark items (Sections 4.1 – 4.2 ; single runs, cues pooled; Claude with larger answer caps), the seven small models answer 32–35% correctly (49–53% outdated) and the five benchmark-track knowers 37–65% (8–47% outdated).
blocks.zh: 预先指定的知识门(第4.4节)在67个不同的模型中留下了20个知情者(表3);图5将其命名。 当地的26个开放量级车型中只有Muse-Glimer-30B型车通过. 其它参数最多可达35B参数,很少给出任何提示下的新省(对被吸收的T1单位的严格精确度最高为5%). 大门下方有3个OpenRouter模型只回答了它的80个物品(Mistral-Large-4,双子座-4-Argon,和LongCat-2.0),因此它们的无克率和前提外泄不明. 三跑无效(第4.4节;*表3),既不算知情者,也不算不知情者,尽管其中两跑尽管输出为空(Muse-Spark-1.2,97%;Qune3.8-Flash,56%),因此知情者计数是一个下限. 所有7,995个基准项目(第4.1至4.2节;单跑、提示集合;Claude的回答上限较大)、7个小模型正确回答32至35%(49至53%已过时)和5个基准轨道知识者37至65%(8至47%已过时)。

blocks.en: Depth. Models name the new province far more often than the new ward (descriptive). Of the knowers with T5 runs, GPT-6, Claude Opus 5.5, and Fable 5.1 name the successor of all 29 absorbed provinces ( T6 ) with no cue but the new ward ( T5 ) far less often (reform cue: Opus 65%, Fable 46%, GPT-6 40%). DeepSeek, GLM-5.3, Claude Haiku 5.5, and Muse-Glimmer know the new province of 68–84% of absorbed wards but the new ward of at most 4% of renamed wards. Empty answers (up to 45%, Claude Fable 5.1) make the T5 accuracy of reasoning models a lower bound.

blocks.en: 5.2 Knowers default to the pre-reform map
blocks.zh: 5.2 已知者对改革前地图的默认

blocks.en: With no cue (Fig. 5 ), 14 of the 20 knowers give only the new province for at most 11% of absorbed T1 wards. At most 16% of their answers name it first (post hoc split), and 14–100% are old-only (Fig. 6 ). GPT-5.5, whose no-cue condition is not date-free (Section 4.2 ), still answers old-only throughout. The other six sometimes answer the new province unprompted: Muse-Glimmer (55%; its template supplies the date), Claude Opus 5.5 (52%), Sonnet 5.5 (51%), Grok-4.7 (41%), HY4 (29%), and GPT-6-Luna (24%). On T1np , 19 of the 20 knowers stay at or below 11%. Either cue recovers the update: eight knowers reach 100% under the reform cue and six under the date cue. The two cues are within 13 points of each other except for four weaker knowers (date vs. reform cue: DeepSeek, 45 vs. 68%; Claude Haiku 5.5, 20 vs. 78%; Opus 4.8, 14 vs. 60%; Sonnet 5, 50 vs. 65%). Under the date cue, new-first rates lie within 9 points of strict accuracy for all 20 knowers, and old-only answers fall to at most 19%, except for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (54%) and Claude Haiku 5.5 (62%).

blocks.en: Premise-leak controls. On absorbed units, most non-knowers do not move under any cue. Three do move under the reform cue (MiniMax-M3 0 → 43 % 0\rightarrow 43\% , MiMo-v2.6-Flash 0 → 21 % 0\rightarrow 21\% , MiMo-v2.6-Pro 0 → 19 % 0\rightarrow 19\% ) and fail the prespecified premise-leak criterion ( < 0.15 <0.15 ), consistent with guessing a plausible merger partner once a merger is named. Under the date cue, which names no change, they stay at 1–8%. We therefore treat Δ date \Delta_{\text{date}} as the main estimate of the default and Δ reform \Delta_{\text{reform}} as an upper bound.
blocks.zh: 精通外出相控. 在被吸收的单位,大多数不知道的人不会在任何提示下移动. 3个确实在改革提示下移动(MiniMax-M3 0 ~ 43 % 0\正权43\%;MiMo-v2.6-Flash 0 ~ 21% 0\正权21\%;MiMo-v2.6-Pro 2.6-Pro 0 → 19 % 0\正权19\%;),不符合预先设定的前提-漏出标准( < 0.15 < 0.15),这与合并命名后可能存在的兼并伙伴猜想一致. 在日期提示下(名称不变),它们保持在1-8%。 因此,我们将\ Delta\text{date} 视为默认的主要估计,并将\ Delta\text{ 改革\ 当作上限 。

blocks.en: Kept units. Under the prespecified kept-unit rule, the cue effects of 17 of the 41 valid non-knowers with kept data are partly premise-induced: the reform cue changes their kept units by 10 points or more, mostly on T6 . Neither cue moves kept T1 and T6 units by over 3 points for DeepSeek, GPT-6, GPT-5.5, and the Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable knowers. Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 move kept wards to a neighboring province under both cues ( − 18 -18 to − 21 -21 points on T1 , − 22 -22 to − 28 -28 on T1np , all established). Muse-Glimmer does so under the reform cue ( − 12 -12 [ − 23 -23 , − 2 -2 ]). On the T5 control (post hoc), the date and reform cues lower the accuracy by 20 points or more for Claude Sonnet 5.5 ( − 22 -22 and − 33 -33 ), Haiku 5.5 with thinking ( − 21 -21 , − 61 -61 ; without it − 2 -2 , − 6 -6 ), and Muse-Glimmer ( − 20 -20 , − 25 -25 ). Claude Haiku 5.5 lies near the prespecified threshold without thinking ( − 9 -9 [ − 17 -17 , − 3 -3 ] on T1 ) and fails it with thinking on T1np ( − 10 -10 [ − 24 -24 , 0 0 ] under the reform cue; − 18 -18 [ − 33 -33 , − 6 -6 ] under the date cue). The kept-unit criterion uses point estimates on 34 to 337 units from 22 to 34 provinces, so decisions near ± 10 \pm 10 points are uncertain. Six families have a model that passes every control (DeepSeek, Zhipu, Anthropic, OpenAI, Tencent, and xAI), which meets the generality criterion; the Moonshot model (Kimi-K3) and the Meta model (Muse-Glimmer without its template date) are cue-dependent but fail the kept-unit control.
blocks.zh: 固定单位。 根据预设的保存单位规则,41个有效不知情者中17个持有保存数据者的提示效应部分是由前提引起的:改革提示改变了他们的保存单位10分或以上,大部分是在T6上. T1和T6单位都保持了3分以上,用于DeepSeek、GPT-6、GPT-5.5和Claude Sonnet、Opus和Fable知识者。 Kimi-K3和GLM-5.3在两个提示下将病房移到相邻的省份(T1上的18-18至21-21分,T1np上的22-22至28-28分,均已建立)。 Muse-Glimmer在改革的提示下这样做( - 12 - 12 [ - 23 - 23, - 2 - 2])。 在T5控制(后临时)上,日期和改革提示将克洛德·索内 5.5(-22-22和-33-33),有思维的海库 5.5(-21-21,-61-61;没有它-2-2,-6-6)和穆斯-格利默(-20-20,-25-25)的精度降低20分或更高. Claude Haiku 5.5位于预先指定的门槛附近,没有思考(-9-9 [-17-17,-3-3] 在T1上),在T1np上思考失败(-10-10 [-24-24,0]在改革提示下;-18-18 [-33-33,-6-6]在日期提示下). 保留单位标准采用从22到34个省份的34到337个单位的点估计,因此在±10\pm 10点附近的决定不确定. 6个家庭有一个模型,通过每个控制(DeepSeek,Zhipu,Anthropic,OpenAI,Tencent,和xAI),它符合通用性标准;月光模型(Kimi-K3)和Meta模型(Muse-Glimer,没有其模板日期)是Cue依赖的,但未能实现保留单元控制.

blocks.en: Dual answers (post hoc). Outside the Claude family, almost no answer names both provinces (Fig. 6 ; GLM-5.3 2%, GLM-5.3-Flash 9%). Claude models often do: Fable 5.1 answers the old province and appends the change in 70% of cases (2% strict accuracy, but 86% of its answers mention the new province), whereas Opus 5.5 gives the new province alone or first in 65% (52% strict) and names both, old first, in 30%.
blocks.zh: 双重答案(临时后)。 在克洛德家族之外,两省几乎没有答复名称(图6;GLM-5.3-2%;GLM-53-Flash-9%)。 Claude Models经常这样做:5.1 回答旧省,附加了70%的病例的变化(2%严格准确,但86%的答案提到了新省),而Opus 5.5 给出了新省单独或65%的第一(52%严格),同时将旧省的名字分别列为30%。

blocks.en: Generations. Of 13 Claude releases (descriptive), the four oldest do not know the reform (at most 5% of absorbed T1 units under any cue); the nine later ones do but give at most 10% on T1 with no cue, except Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 (51–52%).
blocks.zh: 历代相传. 在13个克洛德发布(描述性)中,4个最年长的人不知道改革(在任何提示下被吸收的T1单元中,大多数为5%);9个后来的人知道,但除了Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5(51-52%)以外,最多在T1上给出了10%的提示。

blocks.en: Wording (post hoc). Without the old province in the question ( T1np ), old-only answers remain the rule with no cue (DeepSeek 98%), so the old province is recalled rather than copied. The reform cue still helps every knower, by + 24 +24 to + 100 +100 points, and every cluster interval excludes zero (lowest interval: Claude Opus 4.8, + 24 +24 [12, 35]). Without the brevity suffix (three models, plain system prompt), answers grow from a median of 8–9 to 50–61 characters, and old-only answers stay at 95–100%.
blocks.zh: 语出(后特设. 没有问题中的老省(T1np),老的答案仍然是没有提示的规则(Deep Seek 98%),所以老省被召回而不是被复制. 改革提示仍然帮助每个知情者,通过+24+24到+100+100分,每个集群间隔排除0(最短间隔:克洛德·奥普斯 4.8,+24+24 [12,35]). 没有简洁的后缀(三个模型,平原系统即时),答案从中位数8-9增长到50-61个字符,而老式的答案仍然保持在95-100%.

blocks.en: Frame (post hoc). Asked for the province of a ward by its post-reform name, with no abolished district in the question, DeepSeek, Claude Haiku 5.5, and Muse-Glimmer without its template date still give the old province for 82%, 49%, and 57% of the 120 names that also existed before the reform (Muse-Glimmer with its template: 23%). Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 instead answer the new province first (85–93%, the old one alone for at most 1%) but follow the old map for an old address (85–96% old-only on T1np ): for these models, the default follows the question’s frame. On T1np , a content-free prefix adds at most 5 points to strict accuracy and 8 to the new-first rate, whereas “hiện nay” ( currently ) matches the date for Claude Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, and Fable 5.1 (92–100% new-first), so there the date cue works as a temporal anchor. On T1 , the same prefix raises Sonnet 5.5 from 58% to 78% new-first and Opus 5.5 from 65% to 92%, so part of that cue effect is not temporal.
blocks.zh: 框架(特设后)。 由改革后的名称问出一个选区的行省,问题中没有被废除的行省,DeepSeek, Claude Haiku 5.5,以及没有模板日期的Muse-Glimer仍然给予旧行省82%,49%,以及改革前也存在的120个行省中的57%(Muse-Glimer及其模板:23%). 克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)5.5和5.1寓言首先回答新省(85–93 % , 仅旧省就高达1 % ) , 却按照旧的地址地图(T1np上只有85–96 % ) : 对于这些模型,默认会遵循问题框架。 在T1np上,一个无内容前缀最多增加了5分的严格准确度,8分的新第一率,而"hißn nay"(目前)与Claude Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5和Fable 5.1(92–100%的新第一)的日期相匹配,因此日期提示作为时间锚点起作用. T1上,同名前缀将Sonnet 5.5从58%提升至78%新一,而Opus 5.5则从65%提升至92%,因此该提示效果的一部分不是暂时的.

blocks.en: Reasoning (post hoc). The ladder holds without reasoning (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, thinking off, gains + 68 +68 [52, 83] under the reform cue). Turning on thinking does not remove the default, and for Claude Sonnet 5.5 it lowers no-cue accuracy (51% without thinking vs. 9% with it, when 42% name both, old first), although it helps a weak knower apply a cue (Claude Haiku 5.5 under the date cue: 20 → \rightarrow 94%). Claude Fable 5.1 gives the same picture at its default setting as at the lowest ( T1 , no cue: 1 vs. 2% strict, 24 vs. 14% old-only; reasoning on 79 vs. 82% of cue-ladder items).
blocks.zh: 理由(特设员额)。 梯子不设推理(DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash,思考取出,增收+68+68 [52,83] 在改革提示下). 转而思考并不能消除默认,对克洛德·索内5.5来说,它降低了无阴性精度(51%不思考对9%随同思考,而42%的名字都是老的),尽管它帮助一个弱小的知情者应用了提示(Claude Haiku 5.5在日期提示下:20 ~\正中 94%)。 Claude Fable 5.1在默认设置时给出了与最低设定相同的图片(T1,无提示:1对2%严格,24对14%只使用旧;79对82%的提示梯项的推理).

blocks.en: 5.3 Date placement changes which map is used (post hoc)
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 使用哪个地图的日期位置变化( 临时后)

blocks.en: System prompt or question. With a plain system prompt, every model in Fig. 7 gives 78–100% old-only answers. Today’s date in the system prompt (the “today is” sentence) leaves most answers old-only with reasoning off: of the 12 models (the figure’s eight and Claude Opus 4.7, Opus 4.8, Opus 5, and Sonnet 5, not shown because they lack one cell; reasoned on at most 18% of these items), 10 give 68–100% old-only and 0–30% new-first answers; only Claude Sonnet 5.5 (19%) and Opus 4.7 (31%) give fewer. With reasoning, the same date leaves 70–78% old-only answers for GPT-6 and Kimi-K3 and 29–49% for GPT-6-Luna and Muse-Glimmer. Fable 5.1 answers the new province first (90%), and Opus 5.5 names both, almost always the old province first (96%; as in Fig. 4 , right), which a parser that takes the first name reads as outdated.
blocks.zh: 系统即时或问. 在简单系统的推动下,图7中的每个模型都给出了78-100%的老答案。 今天的系统即时(“今天是”句子)使得大多数答案只有旧的答案才有推理:在12个模型中(该数字的8个和克洛德·奥普斯4.7、奥普斯4.8、奥普斯5和索内德5)没有显示,因为它们缺少一个单元格;最多有18 % , 10个给出了68-100%的旧的和0-30%的新第一答案;只有克洛德·索内德5.5(19 % )和奥普斯4.7(31 % )给出的答案更少。 基于推理,同一日期GPT-6和Kimi-K3的旧有答案分别为70–78%和29–49%,GPT-6-Luna和Muse-Glimer则分别为29–49%。 寓言5.1首先回答新省份(90%),而奥普斯5.5几乎总是先回答旧省份(96%;如图4,右),第一个名称的解说者读来已经过时了。

blocks.en: The date works better in the question. Without reasoning, the “as of” prefix in the question lowers the old-only rate relative to today’s date in the system prompt for all eight models in the figure (GPT-6 − 74 -74 [ − 83 -83 , − 66 -66 ]; established for all but HY4, − 8 -8 [ − 22 -22 , + 8 +8 ]), and raises the new-first rate to 14–96%. Still, 10–86% of the answers stay old-only for every model except Sonnet (1%). The same “today is” sentence moved into the question helps six of the eight ( − 14 -14 to − 76 -76 , all established), whereas the “as of” instruction in the system prompt helps only three and makes GPT-5.6-Terra worse ( + 12 +12 [4, 22]). With reasoning, “as of” in the question leaves no old-only answer for seven of eight models (80–100% new-first; Kimi-K3 − 66 -66 [ − 80 -80 , − 50 -50 ] relative to reasoning off); the exception is Muse-Glimmer (31%). The seven include GLM-5.3 (80% new-first) and Claude Fable 5 (100%), which ran only some placements and are not in Fig. 7 ; GPT-5.6-Terra, asked to reason, did so on 1–36% of items in three of five conditions, and HY4’s reasoning runs are invalid in two. On 300 units from all 29 absorbed provinces (six models, reasoning off), “as of” in the question again lowers the old-only rate for every model ( − 12 -12 [ − 21 -21 , − 3 -3 ] for HY4 to − 76 -76 [ − 82 -82 , − 70 -70 ] for GPT-6).
blocks.zh: 日期在问题中效果更好. 在没有推理的情况下,问题中的 " as of " 前缀将数字中所有8个模型(GPT-6 - 74 - 74 [-83-83,-66-66];除HY4,-8-8 [-22-22,+8+8])之外,新首发率提高到14-96%。 然而,除了Sonnet(1%)之外,10-86%的答案只针对每一个模型。 同样的“今天是”句子移入问题帮助了8个中的6个(-14-14至-76-76,全部确定),而系统中的“截至”指示只帮助了3个,使GPT-5.6-Terra更糟糕(+12+12 [4,22])。 从推理上看,问题中的 " 至上 " 对八个模型中的七个模型(80-100%新一;Kimi-K3 - 66-66[-80-80,-50-50])没有旧的答案;例外的是Muse-Glimmer(31%)。 7个项目包括GLM-5.3(80%新首发)和克洛德5(100%),它们只做了一些工作,没有在图7中;GPT-5.6-Terra被要求说明原因,在5个条件中的3个条件中1-36%的项目上做了,HY4的推理运行在2个条件中无效。 对于来自所有29个被吸收的省份的300个单位(6个型号,推理),问题中的“截至”再次将每个型号的旧有率降低(HY4的−12-12 [−21-21,−3-3]到-76 [−82-82,−70-70] GPT-6).

blocks.en: Told in the system prompt that today is January 1, 2025, every model gives 80–100% old-only answers on absorbed T1 wards, including Claude Opus 5.5, which gives 6% old-only answers on the same 80 T1 units under the plain system prompt (Fig. 7 shows T1np ). The post-reform date in the same position leaves 41–99% old-only answers for nine of the 12 models with reasoning off (Claude Opus 4.7, 14%; Opus 5 and Sonnet 5.5, 1%). In the question, “as of January 2025” gives 88–100% old-only answers for nine of 11 models tested but 45–46% for GPT-6-Luna and HY4.
blocks.zh: 系统提示说,今天是2025年1月1日,每个模型对被吸收的T1病房给出了80-100%的旧有答案,其中包括克劳德·奥普斯·5.5,后者在平地系统提示下对相同的80个T1单元给出了6%的旧有答案(图7显示了T1np ) 。 同一位置的后改革日期为12个模型中的9个留下了41-99%的旧有答案(克洛德·奥普斯4.7,14%;奥普斯5和索内特5.5,1%). 在这个问题中, " 截止2025年1月 " 对11个测试模型中的9个给出了88-100%的老化答案,但对GPT-6-Luna和HY4给出了45-46%的答案。

blocks.en: Agent settings and chat template. Offered a get_current_date tool without a call instruction, five of six models without reasoning never called it, and GPT-6-Luna called it for 29% of the questions, each time answering with the old province. With the tool result or an earlier turn (reasoning off), 69–99% of answers stay old-only ( 1–28% new-first), and none of these conditions moves a kept ward. Only with reasoning on and an instruction to call the tool does GPT-6-Luna mostly apply the fetched date (29% old-only). Rewriting the question with DeepSeek lowers the old-only rate for all six answering models but inserts the old province as a premise into 7 of the 80 absorbed questions (9%) and costs 8–12 points on kept units. In Muse-Glimmer’s chat template, the system block stating a knowledge cutoff and today’s date switches the map: without it the model shows the API models’ default (on T1 , 9% correct and 89% old-only), and with a pre-reform date it gives 99% old-only answers.
blocks.zh: 代理设置和聊天模板 。 提供了一个没有呼叫指令的get_current_date工具,没有推理的6个模型中有5个从未使用过它,而GPT-6-Luna则将它称为29%的问题,每次回答旧行省. 随着工具结果或更早的转折(合理性关闭),69-99 %的答案只保留了旧的(1-28 % 的新第一),这些条件都没有移动一个被保留病房。 GPT-6-Luna只应用取来的日期(29%为旧日期), 用 DeepSeek 重写这个问题会降低所有六个答题模式的旧有率, 但将旧省作为前提插入80个被吸收的问题中的7个(9%), 在Muse-Glimer的聊天模板中,表示知识截断的系统块和今天的日期切换了地图:没有它,模型会显示API模型的默认值(在T1上,9 % 正确,只有89%的旧有),并且有一个改革前的日期给出99%的旧有答案.

blocks.en: Retrieval. Figure 8 summarizes the benchmark track (descriptive; single runs of 12 models; cues pooled). On the stratified 1,262-item subset, a post-reform passage lets the small models answer 71–98% of the items correctly, but with old and new passages both from Wikipedia or both templates, 14–30% of their answers are outdated (Fig. 8 , left), against 2–19% with the new passage alone, and stating each passage’s date recovers at most 4 points. The five knowers, which also differ from the small models in size or provider, give outdated answers in only 0–5% (0–0.8% with the new passage alone). With a new Wikipedia excerpt and an old template passage, the small models give outdated answers to 32–62% of the 220 such items of the full set (1–34% with the new passage alone), against 1–16% for the knowers (Haiku 16%, Muse-Glimmer 10%, the others 1–6%). Without diacritics, T4 accuracy with the post-reform passage (400 twin pairs) changes by at most 6 points for six of the seven small models; Qwen3.5-2B rises from 5% to 49%, because with diacritics it mostly gives the old address (74%).
blocks.zh: 取取来. 图8概述了基准轨迹(说明性;12个模式的单行跑;提示集合)。 在分级的1,262项子集上,一个改革后的段落让小模型正确回答71-98%的项目,但用维基百科或两个模板的旧段落和新段落,14-30%的答案已经过时(图8,左),而只有新段落的2-19 % , 并且说明每个段落的日期在最多4分恢复。 这五个知道者在大小或提供者方面也与小模型不同,他们只给出了0–5%的过时答案(0–0.8 %,仅新段落即可). 随着维基百科新节选和旧模板段落的出现,小模型给出了32-62%的过时答案,而全集220个此类项目(单是新段落为1-34 %)的答案,而知情者为1-16%(Haiku 16%,Muse-Glimer 10%,其他为1-6% )。 没有二甲校正,与改革后通道(400对双对)的T4精度在7个小型号中的6个型号中最多以6分变化;而Quen3.5-2B则由5%上升至49%,因为二甲校正时大多给出了旧地址(74%).

blocks.en: The 2 × 2 2{\times}2 control. The small models answer 73–91% of the pure control ( pc = 0 , wc = 0 \textsc{pc}{}=0,\textsc{wc}{}=0 ) correctly but 0–1% of the cell pc = 1 , wc = 1 \textsc{pc}{}=1,\textsc{wc}{}=1 (province merged, ward changed), where 88–95% of their answers are pre-reform (Fig. 8 , right). blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: 6.1 What the default means
blocks.zh: 6.1 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 默认意味着什么

blocks.en: A closed-book probe that asks plainly would report most knowers as outdated, mistaking a default for missing knowledge, and one that names the event would report them as updated, overstating what a user typing an old address receives. We do not measure training data. The old map may dominate because effective cutoffs often lag reported ones ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) and older text about it abounds.
blocks.zh: 一个公开询问的闭页调查器会报告大多数知情者已经过时,错误地认为缺少知识是默认的,一个给事件起名的人会报告更新,高估一个输入旧地址的用户收到的信息. 我们不衡量培训数据。 旧地图可能占主导地位,因为有效的断接点往往滞后于所报告的断接点(Cheng等,2024年),有关断接点的更古老的文本也很多。

blocks.en: 6.2 How a date takes effect
blocks.zh: 6.2 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 日期如何生效

blocks.en: A date in the system prompt may set the present, and one in the question may scope the query. Reasoning changes how a date is used, but the default persists on items without measured reasoning, though short internal reasoning may go unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 系统提示中的日期可以设定当前,问题中的日期可以限定查询范围. 原因改变使用日期的方式,但默认在项目上继续存在,没有经过衡量的推理,虽然内部推理很短,可能无法衡量。

blocks.en: Prompted earlier cutoffs suppress knowledge causally related to a later event in only about 19% of cases for models without reasoning ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . In our runs, a pre-reform date in the system prompt gives 80–100% old-only answers on absorbed T1 units for every model tested, but 12 of these 16 models give 89–100% already without a date. The other four (Claude Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Sonnet 5.5, and Muse-Glimmer) also respond to a post-reform date there (6–70% to 0–38% old-only), so these runs do not show that the two directions of a date differ (Section 5.3 ).

blocks.en: 6.3 Using the resource
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 使用资源

blocks.en: Evaluations on ViAdminShift should report new-first and old-only rates alongside strict accuracy, report whether the model actually reasoned (as measured, not as requested), include the kept units, and cluster intervals by old province. They should exclude the 779 copyable items (listed in the release) from per-type and 2 × 2 2{\times}2 analyses (middle cells: Section 5.4 ), and the 19 T3 items on new wards from outdated rates.
blocks.zh: 对 ViAdminShift 的评价应报告新第一和旧的费率,同时严格准确,报告模型是否(按衡量,而不是按要求)实际说明理由,包括保留单位,以及按旧省份分列的分组间隔。 它们应把779个可复制物品(在释放中列出)排除在每类物品之外,把2×2 2×times}2个分析(中间细胞:第5.4节)和新病房的19个T3物品排除在过时费率之外。

blocks.en: In our runs, scoping the question in time (“as of ⟨ \langle date ⟩ \rangle ”) worked better than today’s date in the system prompt or a date tool, so address-handling services may prefer it; they should also check unchanged units, because the date cue makes Kimi-K3 and GLM-5.3 move kept wards to a neighboring province (Section 5.2 ). Operators should check the deployed chat template, which may insert a date they never see, and probe each endpoint for a date added by the provider ( Sanz-Guerrero et al., 2026 ) . Dual answers are safer than silent old ones only if parsers do not take the first name.

blocks.en: ∙ \bullet Scope. One reform, one language, and our templates, not user queries: the design transfers to other reorganizations; our numbers may not. A question naming an abolished district also admits the old answer as a literal reading; the post-reform names of Section 5.2 suggest this reading for Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1, not for DeepSeek and Haiku 5.5. In the cell pc = 1 , wc = 1 \textsc{pc}{}=1,\textsc{wc}{}=1 , T1 membership, T4 , and T5 items cover only wards whose province name changed, the control cells are small (43 old wards in the pure control, 84 in the other), and the date cue uses one date. ∙ \bullet Data. Gold answers follow the structure of July 1, 2025, not the 2026 unit-type changes, which precede our prompt date (Section 3.7 ). Divided wards appear in no item whose answer is a new ward, and the five island special zones in no ward-level item. The NSO table determines every pair but one (only two independent lineages exist), manual checks are small samples, and the fine structure of divided wards was hand-checked for four of the 441. Public items may enter later training data. ∙ \bullet Models and the gate. The gate is behavioral: stated cutoffs are rarely available, so whether they predict it could not be checked. Below it, the reform-cue gains of MiniMax-M3 and the two MiMo models (19 to 43 points) may be premise-induced guessing; above it, a model may have seen only coverage of the reform, and accuracies near 0.50 may be partly premise-induced (non-knowers reach 43%). The local-model evidence, including the chat-template experiment, rests on Muse-Glimmer -30B, run at 8 bits with no 16-bit comparison. ∙ \bullet Runs and endpoints. In three repeated runs of the 80 absorbed T1 units for four models, an item gets the same label in all three runs for 80–100% of the items of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and Muse-Glimmer (no template date), but for only 56% and 59% in two cells with intermediate rates (Claude Sonnet 5.5 at none , Haiku 5.5 at date ) and 74% for Haiku 5.5 at reform , so single-run rates are not properties of items; aggregate rates varied by up to 10 points across repeats, and adding the plain system prompt moved single cells by up to 45 (Section 4.3 ); the intervals include neither. Ward-level results rest on 24 to 29 province mappings (Section 4.6 ). API results reflect the models as served, with no record of provider or snapshot, and no-date conditions off the probed reseller may contain a provider-added date (Section 4.2 ). ∙ \bullet Date experiments. GLM-5.3 ran only with “today is” in the system prompt and “as of” in the question, confounding placement and phrasing. The agent settings use one tool and one system instruction, with reasoning only for GPT-6-Luna. ∙ \bullet Benchmark track. It used seven small models that do not know the reform and five that do, Muse-Glimmer-30B and four API models (Section 4.1 ), which also differ from them in size or provider; Claude closed-book results depend on answer caps (Sonnet’s most), and most evidence on knowers comes from the probing track. For 79% of the items (6,303 of 7,995), the new passage is a template, cleaner than real documents, so retrieval results likely overstate performance on mixed-date text. ∙ \bullet Scoring. The probing-track scorer was validated only on 200 province answers ( T1 , T1np ), by the two authors, blind but knowing the rules; it undercounts new-first answers. blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: ViAdminShift turns the 2025 reform into a Vietnamese test of updated knowledge. Its old-to-new tables, checked against an independent lineage, yield 7,995 items with exact post-reform answers, a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 control of unchanged units, diacritic-free address twins, and old and new retrieval passages. Most knowers default to the pre-reform map, and placing the question in time usually switches them to the new one. Post hoc, a date in the question works best, whereas with reasoning off, today’s date in the system prompt, a tool result, or an earlier turn leaves most answers silently outdated. Small models without the update often give outdated answers with mixed passages; the five benchmark-track knowers, which also differ in size or provider, rarely do.
blocks.zh: ViAdminShift将2025年改革变成越南对最新知识的考验. 其从旧到新表格,对照独立的一行取出7,995个物品,并附有确切的后改革后答案,一个2×2 2×times}2 控制不变单元,二相无地址双胞胎,以及新旧取回通道. 大多数知道者默认了改革前的映射,将问题放入时间通常会把它们切换到新的. 事后,问题中的某个日期最有效,而通过推理,今天在系统中的日期即时,工具结果,或更早的转折,大多数答案都无声地过时了。 没有更新的小型模型往往会给出有混合段落的过时答案;5个基准-轨道知识者也大小或提供者不同,但很少如此.

blocks.en: Future work can test other event-level updates and languages, and whether fine-tuning or knowledge editing can move a model’s default, not only its knowledge.
blocks.zh: 未来的工作可以测试其他事件级别的更新和语言,以及微调还是知识编辑可以移动一个模型的默认,而不仅仅是它的知识.

blocks.en: Ethics and Data Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守和数据说明

blocks.en: We use the data statement schema ( Bender and Friedman, 2018 ) for a written, template-generated resource; the released datasheet answers the other questions.
blocks.zh: 我们使用数据语句 schema(Bender and Friedman, 2018)作为书面的,模板生成的资源;发布的数据表回答了其他问题.

blocks.en: Curation rationale. Official tables fix thousands of facts changed on one date. Items cover all 63 old and 34 new provinces and 1,708 old wards in all four 2 × 2 2{\times}2 cells.
blocks.zh: 解释理由。 官方表格在同一个日期纠正了上千个事实。 物品覆盖了所有63个老省和34个新省,以及所有4个2×2×2×2×2个2个囚室的1 708个旧病房。

blocks.en: Language variety. All text is standard written Vietnamese (vi-VN, Unicode NFC) with official names; only the 400 T4 twins lack diacritics (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: 语言种类. 所有文字均为标准书写越南文(vi-VN,Unicode NFC)并有官方名称;只有400个T4双胞胎缺乏二甲状腺素(第3.4节.

blocks.en: Speakers, annotators, and text. Except for the Wikipedia editors (demographics unknown), no speakers or users are represented. No crowd workers were employed; the manual checks and the scorer-validation labels were done by the two authors, both native speakers (Section 3.6 ). Items are short, well-formed questions about one unit, so results may not transfer to real queries that drop diacritics, abbreviate names, or mix old and new names. The data contain no personal information; T4 addresses use synthetic house numbers and hamlets.
blocks.zh: 发言者、注释员和文本。 除维基百科编辑(人口不详)外,无发言者或用户代表. 没有雇用群众工人;人工检查和计分员认证标签由两位提交人进行,他们都是讲母语的人(第3.6节)。 物品是短而成形的关于一个单位的问题,因此结果可能不会转移到真正的询问中去去去掉二甲字,缩写取名,或者将旧名和新名相混合. 数据中没有个人信息;T4地址使用合成房号和小屋.

blocks.en: Speech situation. All text is written and edited: template questions and passages over official unit names, meant for evaluating models, and Wikipedia revisions from before and after the reform (Section 3.5 ), written for general readers.
blocks.zh: 演讲情况。 所有文字都写作并编辑:在官方单位名称上标出模板问题和段落,意在评价模型,以及改革前后维基百科的修订(第3.5节),为一般读者所编写.

blocks.en: Collection, compute, and intended use. All sources were retrieved from their public sites (Wikipedia via its API, about two requests per second), and local models ran on a rented four-GPU RTX 4090 server and on CPU servers. ViAdminShift measures model knowledge; it is not an address converter.
